SELECT m.id, m.parent_id AS parentId, m.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, m.menu_name AS menuName, m.menu_type AS menuType, m.path, m.component, m.route_name AS routeName, m.permission, m.icon, m.sort_order AS sort, m.visible, m.status, m.keep_alive AS keepAlive, m.external_link AS externalLink, m.remark, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.created_at AS createTime FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = m.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
m.deleted = 0
AND m.menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{menuName}, '%')
AND m.status = #{status}
ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu (parent_id, app_id, menu_name, menu_type, path, component, route_name, permission, icon, sort_order, visible, status, keep_alive, external_link, remark, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{appId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{path}, #{component}, #{routeName}, #{permission}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{visible}, #{status}, #{keepAlive}, #{externalLink}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
